name: What property types can be used for diversification within an investment portfolio?

mainEntity.name: What property types can be used for diversification within an investment portfolio?

acceptedAnswer.text: Within an investment property portfolio, diversification can involve various property types such as single-family homes, multi-family units, condominiums, or even commercial spaces. Each type carries its own risk and return characteristics. For example, residential properties often provide stable rental income, while commercial properties might offer higher yields but come with longer lease terms and different management requirements. Understanding the specific demand and vacancy rates for each property type in areas like Aventura or Boca Raton is key to making informed diversification choices.
acceptedAnswer.description: Property types like single-family, multi-family, condominiums, or commercial spaces offer different risk/return profiles for portfolio diversification.
